rationale: Setup always limits at ss 100C 1.60V max-RC; hold (+0.08-0.11 ns), slew/cap (max 18 vs bar 89) and DRC (all converge to 0) are not binding, so only timing matters. Loose-target runs are IO-limited and T_eff tracks the target; unpressured reg-to-reg is ~5.2 ns, and only ~0.50 targets pushed it to 4.67-4.81 ns with slack left over, so the frontier likely lies below 4.67: pin period_frac 0.46. The two best runs (md5, bm64) both used synthesis sizing and timing-driven placement without routability spreading; the best added AREA 3, cap213 and post-GRT timing repair. DELAY 4 without timing-driven placement collapsed to 7.78 ns. The optimizer tunes util, density, buffering, margins, repair percentages.
